title: agora debate transcript
description: Written next to the Markdown report by `agora run` (same name, .json). Model output in `text`, `moderator` and `synthesis` is untrusted: escape it before showing it as HTML.

schema_version.description: Raised on any change that breaks a reader.

created.description: UTC time the transcript was written.

provider.description: provider/model label, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet or dryrun/canned

planned_rounds.description: Rounds asked for; with --dynamic the debate may end earlier, see rounds.

role.description: The persona description the agent was given; empty if none.

consensus.description: Consensus score after the round (keyword overlap and position alignment), not a measure of truth.

moderator.description: Moderator intervention read before the round; null if there was none.

position.description: The text after the first POSITION: tag; null without a tag.

polarity.description: -1 against, 1 for, 0 without a tag or undecided.

format.description: Present only when the debate ran with --format: the format that fixed roles, phases and the synthesis outline.

disclaimer.description: Shown before the debate, in the report and on the replay page.

evidence.description: Present only when the debate ran with --evidence: the cards every speaker was given. The text is untrusted (it comes from the user's files): escape it before showing it as HTML.

truncated.description: True when the file was longer than the card and was cut.
